import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    ref_customers = inputs["ref_customers"].copy()
    ref_skus = inputs["ref_skus"].copy()
    
    # Initialize rejection reason column
    orders["reason_code"] = None
    
    # R1: customer_id not present in ref_customers
    valid_customers = set(ref_customers["customer_id"].dropna().unique())
    r1_fail = orders["reason_code"].isna() & ~orders["customer_id"].isin(valid_customers)
    orders.loc[r1_fail, "reason_code"] = "CUST_UNKNOWN"
    
    # R2: customer status <> 'ACTIVE'
    # Join with ref_customers to get status
    cust_status = ref_customers[["customer_id", "status"]].copy()
    orders_with_status = orders.merge(cust_status, on="customer_id", how="left")
    r2_fail = (orders["reason_code"].isna() & 
               (orders_with_status["status"] != "ACTIVE"))
    orders.loc[r2_fail, "reason_code"] = "CUST_INACTIVE"
    
    # R3: sku not present in ref_skus
    valid_skus = set(ref_skus["sku"].dropna().unique())
    r3_fail = orders["reason_code"].isna() & ~orders["sku"].isin(valid_skus)
    orders.loc[r3_fail, "reason_code"] = "SKU_UNKNOWN"
    
    # R4: sku discontinued = 1
    sku_info = ref_skus[["sku", "discontinued", "allowed_countries"]].copy()
    orders_with_sku = orders.merge(sku_info, on="sku", how="left")
    r4_fail = (orders["reason_code"].isna() & 
               (orders_with_sku["discontinued"] == 1))
    orders.loc[r4_fail, "reason_code"] = "SKU_DISC"
    
    # R5: allowed_countries non-empty AND ship_country not in list
    # Need to check country blocking
    r5_fail_mask = orders["reason_code"].isna()
    
    for idx in orders[r5_fail_mask].index:
        sku_val = orders.loc[idx, "sku"]
        country_val = orders.loc[idx, "ship_country"]
        
        # Find allowed_countries for this SKU
        sku_rows = ref_skus[ref_skus["sku"] == sku_val]
        if len(sku_rows) > 0:
            allowed_countries = sku_rows.iloc[0]["allowed_countries"]
            
            # Check if allowed_countries is non-empty and not null
            if pd.notna(allowed_countries) and str(allowed_countries).strip() != "":
                # Parse the comma-delimited list (trim each member)
                allowed_list = [c.strip() for c in str(allowed_countries).split(",")]
                allowed_list = [c for c in allowed_list if c]  # Remove empty strings
                
                # Check if ship_country is in the list
                if pd.notna(country_val) and str(country_val).strip() not in allowed_list:
                    orders.loc[idx, "reason_code"] = "CTRY_BLOCKED"
    
    # Split into clean and rejects
    orders_clean = orders[orders["reason_code"].isna()].drop(columns=["reason_code"])
    orders_rejects = orders[orders["reason_code"].notna()][["order_id", "customer_id", "sku", "qty", "ship_country", "reason_code"]]
    
    return {
        "orders_clean": orders_clean,
        "orders_rejects": orders_rejects
    }
